meta.title: Ensure at least once delivery in ClickHouse
meta.body_summary: Apply wait_end_of_query=1 to ClickHouse INSERT and DDL operations to ensure at-least-once delivery and DDL acknowledgment, correcting an earlier global misapplication that would have degraded SELECT query performance.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor correctly scoped wait_end_of_query to INSERT/DDL across TS/Python/Rust clients after prior global misapplication; merged quickly with maintainer approval and non-blocking Copilot bot feedback.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1788 changed lines across 10 files (including extensive documentation file churn), this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume. It fits a cross-client configuration fix that merged after a fast human approval cycle and bot review suggestions, without blocking concerns.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot inline comments suggested: extracting DDL commands into a constant, merging default settings when overriding, adding unit tests for the Rust query_param and Python blocks_runner, and extracting a DRY helper method for wait_end_of_query in Python OlapTable. The human maintainer phiSgr approved without additional comments.
review_details.performance_claim: Ensures at-least-once delivery for INSERT and DDL operations while preserving streaming performance for SELECT queries by not applying wait_end_of_query globally.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor implemented a multi-language client change (TS, Python, Rust) applying a subtle ClickHouse query setting scoped to INSERT and DDL, addressing a prior global misconfiguration. Merge succeeded with fast human approval and non-blocking bot review suggestions, showing capability on configuration-driven database client optimizations.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot provided inline suggestions on code style and test coverage; human maintainer phiSgr approved after reviewing the implementation.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Vercel deployment preview succeeded; no CI performance test mentioned.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance metrics; unit tests verify wait_end_of_query inclusion in INSERT/DDL payloads but do not measure throughput or latency.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The PR corrects an earlier global application of wait_end_of_query that would have harmed SELECT performance; this is a proactive fix within the same development cycle.

core_change_summary.description: Added wait_end_of_query=1 setting to ClickHouse INSERT and DDL queries across TypeScript SDK, Python OLAP table, and Rust ClickHouse client/runner, while explicitly excluding it from SELECT queries to preserve streaming performance. Introduced a helper method in Python OlapTable and a DDL_COMMANDS constant in Rust.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Markdown documentation files were repeatedly added and removed during development; the final state includes only code changes. Unit test file test_olap_table_wait_end_of_query.py was added then removed in a later refactor.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added wait_end_of_query to all insertion paths (TS, Python, Rust) and blocks runners, with documentation.
Second commit: reverted from global to selective application, removed old doc, added corrected doc, and refined Rust query_param logic.
Subsequent commits: documentation churn (added/removed), refined Python actions and blocks runner to merge default settings, added unit tests for wait_end_of_query.
Linter fixes and final refactor: added helper method _with_wait_end_settings in OlapTable, removed test file, and prepared for merge.

review_signals.summary: First review: Reviewed 7/7 files, suggested extracting DDL_COMMANDS constant and merging default settings in blocks_runner; also indicated low-confidence comments on comment placement and unit tests.
review_signals.action_taken: Agent later adopted the DDL_COMMANDS constant and merged default settings in Python blocks_runner.

review_signals.summary: Second review: Reviewed 9/9 files, suggested DRY helper for wait_end_of_query and noted incorrect test patch path.
review_signals.action_taken: Agent refactored to introduce _with_wait_end_settings helper method in OlapTable.

review_signals.summary: Approved the PR with no comments.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial global wait_end_of_query implementation across three client stacks.
Within 1 minute, Copilot bot provided first review with code-quality suggestions.
Within 2 minutes, human maintainer phiSgr approved.
Agent made several force-push updates incorporating bot feedback (DDL_COMMANDS constant, default settings merging, DRY helper).
Bot reviewed the updated version with one additional comment, which the agent addressed.
PR merged after ~18 hours with no blocking reviews.
